scope: newly authored fictional example; no repository fixture or production data
discussion_summary:
The central tension is whether a warmed-cache benchmark can support a general latency claim.

- The baseline includes startup time while the new engine is warmed up, so the comparison does not establish the reported latency improvement.
- The result may still be useful for long-lived services, but a fair warmed-cache comparison and tail-latency measurements would strengthen the evidence.
